scenarios.description: Complete the first capture lesson and verify that setup success persists.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Resume onboarding at Try it in a fresh test profile. Start the practice recording, open Whiteboard from the recording controls, complete the Whiteboard and screen strokes, stop the recording, then select Finish setup.
prerequisites: A checksum-verified Linux AppImage, the pinned Parakeet model and its verification receipt, and a fresh disposable Hyprland guest with working portal capture and input.
Node 22 and a private benchmark job directory on Clanker.
expectedEvidence: The practice lesson reaches Your turn in the separate Whiteboard renderer before the probe draws. The coach then advances to the screen-ink step.
The saved practice bundle has strokes, keyframes and a nonempty recording. Clipboard text references that exact bundle.
The retained onboarding-waits.json contains a verified first-success wait after the coach closes and the config records first-capture completion.
limits: The runner seeds a private profile at the practice stage. Earlier onboarding steps, other platforms and external paste are outside its coverage.
